records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended September 30, 2025 decreased $3.5 million, or 4.1%, to $81.6 million from $85.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2025 was primarily due to declining volumes compared to the prior period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of September 30, 2025, the Company had committed to purchase green coffee inventory totaling $31.6 million under fixed-price contracts, and $12.2 million in inventory and other purchases under non-cancelable purchase orders.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Unit sales decreased 10.9%, and average unit price increased by 7.7% in the three months ended September 30, 2025 as compared to the same period in the prior fiscal year, resulting in a decrease in our net sales of 4.1%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities during the three months ended September 30, 2025 was $5.0 million as compared to net provided by operating activities of $2.5 million in the three months ended September 30, 2024, a decrease in cash used in operations of $7.5 million.
